content.value: The vanilla mace, trident, turtle helmet, and [[item/minecraft:elytra|Elytra]] are always classified as Unique. This classification comes from the item itself and is part of that equipment base.

Their special statistics are a preset part of the item rather than a player-selected random affix pool.
The [[article/runic_altar|Runic Altar]] rejects all operations on them, including random, targeted, Artificial, Divine, Chaos, and Annulment tomes.
They cannot be converted to Magic or Rare and do not use the normal prefix/suffix crafting limits.
Their actual bonuses are shown directly on the item tooltip and are applied when the item is equipped in its proper slot.

A compatible Unique can be improved at the [[article/quality|Upgrade Bench]], receive [[item/cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil|Deepslate Sigil]] slots up to its item-type cap, and use approved enchantments within those slots.
Open the Unique item's article to inspect its fixed rune properties. These properties have their own references and values, separate from the ordinary random-tome catalogues.
